entry.description: The AclEntry the producer wants the maintainer to hold for the subject (intent). The maintainer's response carries the realized AclEntry it now holds.

subject.description: VID of the party in the ACL.

role.description: Opaque role identifier interpreted by the ACL maintainer.

scopes.description: Opaque scope identifiers (e.g. contexts, domains, resource prefixes).

createdBy.description: VID of the party that originally added this entry.

updatedBy.description: VID of the party that last modified this entry.

expiresAt.description: Optional time after which the entry is no longer effective.

Response.title: ACL Grant — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/grant request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/grant/0.1#response.

entry.description: The canonical AclEntry the maintainer now holds for the subject.
